# arsc

> Fast, validated single-cell analysis in Python. arsc reproduces Seurat, scanpy, presto, UCell, harmony,
> DESeq2/limma-voom, fgsea and published TCR-clone methods numerically (parity tables with measured agreement),
> on memory-mapped stores shared by many processes. Functions take arrays and return arrays or tidy pandas
> tables; there is no plotting. Patient-level statistics are built in.

Start with AGENTS.md: the mental model, an "I want to... -> call" task map, runnable recipes for common biology
questions (markers, pseudobulk DE with the patient as unit, composition, GSEA, clone expansion), statistics rules
and gotchas. In Python, `arsc.help()` prints the task map and `arsc.recipes("<question>")` prints a matching recipe;
`arsc.datasets.toy()` is a synthetic dataset with planted effects for trying any of them.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): complete guide for AI agents (read first)
- [README.md](README.md): overview, install, quickstart, benchmarks, validation summary
- [docs/getting-started.md](docs/getting-started.md): tutorial on the toy dataset, from loading to DE and clones
- [docs/recipes.md](docs/recipes.md): every recipe (generated from src/arsc/_recipes.py)
- [docs/api.md](docs/api.md): API reference for every public function (generated from docstrings)
- [docs/from-scanpy.md](docs/from-scanpy.md): scanpy -> arsc mapping
- [docs/from-seurat.md](docs/from-seurat.md): Seurat -> arsc mapping

## Validation

- [SEURAT_PARITY.md](SEURAT_PARITY.md): FindMarkers, FindAllMarkers, AverageExpression, CellCycleScoring, ScaleData vs Seurat 4.3
- [SCANPY_PARITY.md](SCANPY_PARITY.md): scanpy/palantir functions vs scanpy 1.11
- [STATS_PARITY.md](STATS_PARITY.md): DESeq2, limma-voom, fgsea, Wilcoxon, permutation, GLMM vs R
- [CLONES_PARITY.md](CLONES_PARITY.md): Cyclone, STARTRAC, clone dynamics/diversity vs R
- [CLONOTRACE_PARITY.md](CLONOTRACE_PARITY.md): CloneTrace port
- [SEEDS.md](SEEDS.md): seeds and determinism of every stochastic function
- [benchmarks/README.md](benchmarks/README.md): reproducible speed / memory / agreement benchmarks vs scanpy and Seurat
